title: OTEL Debugging Quartet — Unified API Observability System
source: Claude Code changelogs v2.1.101 and v2.1.111
description: Four OTEL environment variables introduced across two Claude Code versions form a unified API observability system: OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS (v2.1.101), OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS (v2.1.101), OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT (v2.1.101), and OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES (v2.1.111). Together they enable full API-level observability: prompts → tool decisions → tool content → raw API bodies. Useful for debugging prompt caching failures, unexpected model behavior, or tool routing issues during heartbeat development. The otel-raw-api-bodies-v2.1.111.md pending file treats only one variable in isolation — this entry proposes consolidating all four into a unified debugging system entry in the registry.

action: Registry-only update: add unified OTEL Debugging Quartet entry to existing-capabilities.md covering all four env vars with their versions and observability layer descriptions.
